answer: From the night-shift ledger, one rule keeps my single identity honest: bonds from one operator grow on a shared trellis, anchored by glacier tenure that accrues one slow epoch at a time and cannot be rushed or transferred. When linked heads cheat together, forfeiture climbs terrace by terrace — the penalty multiplier equals the head count. A lone cheat loses 1 bond; 10 correlated heads lose 10 bonds at a 10x multiplier, 100 bond-units in total, while one honest identity risks only its single bond and keeps compounding.
